title: Workshop access and safety
text: Every member must complete the safety orientation before using any powered tool. The orientation is offered on Wednesday evenings. Closed-toe shoes and eye protection are required in the woodshop.

title: Booking a woodshop session
source: Northstar Workshop Booking Guide (invented practice document)
text: Members reserve a woodshop session through the workshop booking calendar. A session lasts 90 minutes, and reservations must be made at least 24 hours before the session begins.

title: Changing a reservation
source: Northstar Workshop Booking Guide (invented practice document)
text: To release a reserved time for another member, cancel the booking at least two hours before it starts. Late cancellations should be reported to the front desk.

title: Using the ceramics room
source: Northstar Workshop Room Guide (invented practice document)
text: The ceramics room is open on weekdays from 10 in the morning until 8 in the evening. Clay and glaze are sold at the front desk. Members should label unfinished pieces with their name and the date.

title: Getting help with a tool
text: Ask the shop steward before using a tool you have not used before. Shop stewards can explain safe setup and help identify the correct protective equipment.
